entry.title: Announcing Rust 1.100.0. The Rust team is happy to announce a new version of Rust, 1.100.0.
entry.summary:
The Rust team is happy to announce a new version of Rust, 1.100.0. Rust is a programming language empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software. If you have a previous version of Rust installed via rustup , you can get 1.100.0 with: $ rustup update stable If you don't have it already, you can get rustup from the appropriate page on our website, and check out the detailed release notes for 1.100.0 .

Source: Lobste.rs · Tags: #rust #compilers
